edit.find: Collision types $06 and $09 are not traced to a purpose.
edit.with: Collision types $06 and $09 are the diagonal-edge cells: the low nibble of a collision byte is a mask of the four 8x8 quadrants of the 16x16 cell, $06 = top-right + bottom-left (an edge running from lower left to upper right) and $09 = top-left + bottom-right (upper left to lower right). They sit on the diagonal sides of staircases, chamfered cave and wall corners and the ramp gate towers (145 of 223 scenes carry each). Why the test above needs the (+X,+Y) neighbour is not traced.
